CustomField.description: THE FEED’S OWN TIMESTAMP, not Salesforce’s clock. FSD 5.9.6 step 2 halts on a stale sync, and staleness is only meaningful against the source: a feed that is three days old but was fetched two minutes ago IS stale, and measuring against Started_DateTime__c would call it fresh.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How old the Yardi data itself is. Staleness is judged against this, not against when the job ran.
CustomField.label: Feed As Of
